zones.name: Main Academy Campus
zones.theme: Modern Multistory High School Academic Wing
zones.features: Polished linoleum corridors, multistory classroom wings, faculty staff room, comprehensive library, chemistry labs, high-altitude rooftop, and wide main entrance foyer with shoe lockers.
zones.sensory: Echoes of rhythmic school bells, muffled lectures from closed classroom doors, crisp scent of cedar chalkboards and textbook paper, and bright daylight streaming through tall windows.

zones.name: School Grounds & Athletics
zones.theme: Varsity Athletic Stadium & Physical Training Complex
zones.features: Full-size indoor gymnasium arena, 400-meter all-weather running track encircling an astroturf stadium field, competition aquatics pool facility, martial arts dojo, and equipment storage sheds.
zones.sensory: Shrill coach whistles, squeaking rubber sneakers on polished hardwood, smell of athletic chalk and sunscreen, and roar of spectators echoing off aluminum bleachers.

zones.name: Student Commons & Central Plaza
zones.theme: Vibrant Outdoor Social Commons & Campus Dining Hub
zones.features: Sunlit central brick promenade, campus dining hall with terrace balcony seating, century-old flowering cherry tree, vending machine pavilion, and botanical glasshouse.
zones.sensory: Chatter and laughter of friend groups sharing lunch, gentle hum of cold drink vending machines, sweet aroma of freshly brewed tea, curry, and cherry blossom petals drifting on the breeze.

zones.name: Cultural Arts & Student Union
zones.theme: Eclectic Multi-Story Creative & Club Activities Annex
zones.features: Grand proscenium auditorium stage, labyrinthine hallway of student clubrooms plastered with colorful flyers, acoustic music rehearsal halls, fine arts studios, and student council headquarters.
zones.sensory: Overlapping sounds of brass trumpet scales, echoing stage dialogue rehearsals, the pungent scent of oil paints and acrylic markers, and enthusiastic debate from open clubroom doors.

zones.name: Commercial District
zones.features: Pedestrian shopping street lined with colorful storefronts, glowing arcade entrances, cozy café awnings, and 24/7 convenience stores.
zones.sensory: Upbeat chiptune melodies from arcades, aroma of roasted coffee and pastries from street vendors, and warm neon signs illuminating the sidewalk.

zones.name: Residential Neighborhood
zones.features: Narrow paved streets with walled residences, tranquil neighborhood playground parks, utility poles strung with wires, and tidy front gardens.
zones.sensory: Warm ambient sunlight casting soft shadows, gentle rustle of leaves in the breeze, distant chime of neighborhood clocks, and a calm, peaceful quiet.

zones.name: Seaside & Coastal Bay
zones.features: Expansive golden sand beach, wooden boardwalk pier, whitewashed coastal lighthouse, and breezy waterfront snack shacks.
zones.sensory: Rhythmic sound of crashing ocean waves, salty sea spray on the skin, wheeling seagulls calling overhead, and warm seaside sun.

zones.name: Recreational Mountain Park
zones.features: Dense pine woods with hiking trails, wooden campsite cabins, tranquil mountain lake, and a panoramic summit lookout deck.
zones.sensory: Crisp mountain air scented with pine needles, gentle lapping of lake water, chirping forest birds, and panoramic valley views.

zones.name: Abandoned Old Campus Building
zones.theme: Decaying Showa-Era Heritage Wing & Clock Tower
zones.features: Crumbling concrete walls overgrown with creeping ivy, broken classroom windows, dust-covered hallways, mechanical clock tower with exposed gearworks, and abandoned gymnasium.
zones.sensory: Ominous creak of warped floorboards, whistling draft carrying cold dust and damp mildew, rhythmic deep mechanical clank of the clock tower gears, and eerie silence.

zones.name: Rumored Haunted Hill Manor
zones.theme: Dilapidated Victorian Estate on the Hill
zones.features: Wrought-iron front gate, peeling dark wallpaper, dusty chandelier foyers, and overgrown overgrown weeping willow garden.
zones.sensory: Creaking floorboards underfoot, cold drafts sweeping through dark doorways, scent of antique wood, and faint unnatural whispers.

zones.name: Capital City
zones.features: Towering white limestone ramparts, grand vaulted guild halls, cobblestone merchant plazas, and gilded imperial palace spires.
zones.sensory: The aroma of fresh hearth bread and roasting meats, clinking armor of passing town guards, ringing blacksmith anvils, and vibrant calls of merchant criers.

zones.name: Woodlands & Forest
zones.features: Tall pine and oak canopy, winding hunter trails, logging timber yards, sunlit clearings, and roadside coaching wayposts.
zones.sensory: Crisp pine scent, chirping woodland birds, rustling ferns underfoot, and soft shafts of sunlight through the leafy branches.

zones.name: Ancient Woods
zones.features: Massive ironwood trees with intertwined root bridges, moss-draped stone monoliths, glowing mushroom groves, and hidden bramble-choked pathways.
zones.sensory: Dappled emerald canopy light, the rustle of unseen wildlife in dense foliage, damp forest loam, and a faint ozone tingle of raw ambient mana.

zones.name: Central Farmlands & Plains
zones.features: Golden wheat fields stretching to the horizon, quaint windmills, thatched-roof farming hamlets, and busy roadside coaching inns.
zones.sensory: Warm golden sunlight, the scent of hay and sweet grass, the gentle clatter of horse carts, and singing field hands.

zones.name: Coastal Harbor Town
zones.features: Stone quays lined with wooden merchant galleons, fish markets, shipwright docks, and seaside taverns.
zones.sensory: The pungent smell of tar and fresh fish, creaking ship rigging in the breeze, calling seagulls, and rhythmic ocean surf.

zones.name: High Mountain Range
zones.features: Sheer granite cliffs, treacherous winding mountain passes, dwarven mining fortresses carved into rock faces, and soaring stone bridges.
zones.sensory: Biting mountain winds, the rhythmic clanging of heavy pickaxes echoing through stone shafts, crisp thin air, and echoes of tumbling gravel.

zones.name: Swamp & Marshes
zones.features: Stagnant black waterways, twisted cypress trees dripping with moss, rickety wooden boardwalks, and sunken stone ruins.
zones.sensory: Damp clinging mist, the smell of decomposing vegetation and wet peat, distant eerie bubbling, and croaking marsh toads.

zones.name: Desert Dunes & Oasis
zones.features: Towering shifting golden dunes, sandstone ruins half-buried in sand, and lush palm-shaded oasis pools.
zones.sensory: Blistering desert heat, howling sandstorms carrying dry grit, sweet scent of dates and fresh water at the oasis, and shimmering heat mirages.

zones.name: Frozen Snow & Tundra
zones.features: Vast snowdrifts, frozen glacial crevasses, mammoth bone shelters, and towering blue-ice pillars.
zones.sensory: Howling sub-zero blizzards, crunching snow under heavy boots, numbing frostbite, and shimmering auroras across starry night skies.

zones.name: Volcanic Ashlands
zones.features: Rivers of glowing orange magma, obsidian crags, billowing sulfur vents, and glowing basalt formations.
zones.sensory: Oppressive scorching heat, choking smell of sulfur and ash, rumbling tremors in the ground, and glowing red embers floating on the air.

zones.name: Cursed Shadowlands
zones.features: Twisted dead black trees, purple necrotic mist, shattered gothic mausoleums, and ground littered with bleached bones.
zones.sensory: Unnatural bone-chilling cold, dead silence devoid of insect or animal life, smell of decay and grave dust, and unsettling ghostly whispers.

zones.name: Underworld Chasm
zones.features: Vast subterranean caverns, glowing fungal forests, underground dark lakes, and ancient drow stone architecture.
zones.sensory: Echoing drips of water in massive hollows, soft cyan and violet glow of giant mushrooms, cool damp air, and the scurrying of chitinous beasts.

zones.name: Ancient Dungeon Complex
zones.features: Heavy iron-banded doors, stone-tiled corridors laced with ancient pressure plates, vaulted treasury vaults, and monster holding pens.
zones.sensory: Flickering wall torches casting long shadows, smell of stale air and old blood, the heavy scrape of moving stone traps, and distant monstrous growls.

zones.name: Deep Cave Network
zones.features: Towering glittering crystal geodes, narrow crawlspaces, roaring underground waterfalls, and deep mineral veins.
zones.sensory: Roar of subterranean rivers, sparkling light refracting through raw gemstones, cold dripping dampness, and mineral-rich air.

zones.features: Jagged purple rock formations, red lightning in the sky, shattered demonic battlefields, and blighted fortresses.

zones.name: Tiered Labyrinth Dungeon
zones.theme: Multilevel Dungeon Labyrinth with Safe Zones
zones.features: Carved stone floors, magical teleportation circles, monster spawn chambers, and crystal-lit safe areas.
zones.sensory: Humming magical circles on stone floors, smell of potions and ozone, distant echoes of clashing swords, and faint monster cries.

zones.name: Black-Iron Citadel
zones.features: Serrated black iron battlements piercing storm clouds, spiked portcullis gates, bottomless oubliettes, and vaulted naves with shattered stained glass.
zones.sensory: Howling mountain gale shrieking through narrow arrow slits, crackle of pitch-soaked torches casting jagged shadows, and the scent of cold stone, dried blood, and burning coal.

zones.name: Plague-Blighted Marshes
zones.features: Decaying stilt huts rising above stagnant black water, gallows hill execution grounds, sunken bone chapels, and twisted wicker effigy groves.
zones.sensory: Choking damp fog clinging to the skin, sickly sweet stench of rotting bogwood and wet earth, eerie silence broken only by croaking ravens, and distant guttering torchlight.

zones.name: Gallows Hill Settlement
zones.features: Weathered timber homes fortified with iron stakes, town square gibbets, fortified watchtowers, and a somber tavern.
zones.sensory: The mournful creak of ropes swaying from gallows trees, pungent smell of pitch smoke, subdued fearful murmuring of townsfolk, and distant howling.

zones.name: Sunken Bone Catacombs
zones.features: Walls stacked high with human skulls, ancient limestone sarcophagi, poisoned spike traps, and flooded burial chambers.
zones.sensory: Freezing subterranean draft, the smell of damp embalming fluids and rot, sound of crunching bone dust, and faint scratching behind stone walls.

zones.name: Blood-Ash Crags
zones.features: Razor-sharp black obsidian crags, iron gibbet cages hanging over chasms, ruined sentinel towers, and freezing ash-laden mists.
zones.sensory: Screaming freezing winds, the metallic clang of swinging iron cages, stinging cold ash, and barren desolation.

zones.name: Desecrated Cathedral Grounds
zones.features: Fallen stone pillars, desecrated golden statuary, shattered stained-glass windows depicting dying gods, and heretical ritual circles.
zones.sensory: Echoing footsteps in vast hollow stone halls, scent of incense mixed with old blood, flickering tallow candles, and deep dreadful silence.

zones.name: Withered Ancient Woods
zones.theme: Dead Twisted Forest & Beast Prowl Grounds
zones.features: Barkless pale white trees resembling grasping hands, thorny black briars, corrupted hunting trails, and cannibal hunter camps.
zones.sensory: Crackling dead branches underfoot, eerie dead silence broken by sudden savage shrieks, rotting mulch smell, and pitch-black canopy darkness.

zones.name: Underground Vault Shelter
zones.features: Heavy steel cog-shaped blast doors, yellow fluorescent-lit metal corridors, hydroponic food bays, and overseer command suites.
zones.sensory: Persistent hum of air filtration turbines, sterile recycled ozone, buzzing fluorescent lighting, and echoing metal grating underfoot.

zones.name: Scrap-Town Settlement
zones.features: Corrugated iron shanties, perimeter walls made of rusted automobile shells, water purification windmill rigs, and lively barter stalls.
zones.sensory: The smell of roasting mystery meat over oil drums, clinking bottle caps and shell casings, shouting merchants, and churning water pumps.

zones.name: Irradiated Crater Basin
zones.features: Vitrified radioactive glass craters, glowing toxic slurry pools, warped skeletonized skyscrapers, and mutant beast nests.
zones.sensory: Frantic clicking of Geiger counters, eerie green phosphorescent glow in the gloom, ozone and burning rubber smell, and howling ash dust.

zones.name: Highway Badlands & Scrapyards
zones.theme: Cracked Desert Asphalt & Wrecked Vehicle Graveyard
zones.features: Multi-lane cracked highway overpasses, miles of stripped car wrecks, roadside sniper towers, and billboard sniper perches.
zones.sensory: Blistering dry heat, the roar of motorized raider buggies in the distance, howling wind through rusted steel, and blowing sand.

zones.name: Ruined Megacity Ruins
zones.features: Crumbling skyscraper canyons, collapsed subway tunnels, overgrown commercial plazas, and scavenged corporate towers.
zones.sensory: Eerie echoes through concrete canyons, sudden clatter of falling rubble, smell of wet dust and rust, and prowling feral beasts.

zones.name: Iron Raider Stronghold
zones.theme: Fortified Industrial Scrap Citadel & Combat Pit
zones.features: Towering sheet-metal barricades topped with barbed wire, scrap-iron arena cages, heavy vehicle repair garages, and slave pens.
zones.sensory: Roaring diesel engines, screaming raider warbands, heavy metal music blaring from salvaged PA horns, and burning tire bonfires.

zones.name: Toxic Chemical Swamplands
zones.theme: Flooded Industrial Chemical Basin & Mutant Marsh
zones.features: Corrosive chemical pools glowing dull amber, dead bleached tree trunks, rusted oil refinery pipes, and floating mutant carcasses.
zones.sensory: Acrid burning chemical fumes, hissing corrosive acid bubbles, suffocating oily smog, and the splash of heavy submerged mutant horrors.

zones.name: City Center & Megacorp Plaza
zones.features: Gleaming chrome-and-glass skyscrapers, elevated mag-train skybridges, biometric security scanner gates, and manicured rooftop helipads.
zones.sensory: Pristine filtered air, cold blue ambient LED strips, the quiet hum of automated surveillance drones, and the rhythmic hiss of pressurized pneumatic doors.

zones.name: Downtown Commercial Core
zones.features: Vibrant pedestrian malls, colossal 3D holographic advertisements, multi-tier skywalks, and high-end cyberware retail outlets.
zones.sensory: Pulsing electronic store jingles, neon lights washing over crowds in pink and cyan, smell of synthetic street coffee, and rushing air-car traffic.

zones.name: Uptown Heights & Penthouses
zones.features: Private residential spires towering above the smog layer, private security checkpoints, glass-bottom sky pools, and automated luxury transit.
zones.sensory: Clean crisp high-altitude breeze, quiet luxury hum of private hover-limos, soft ambient lounge synth, and clear views of the stars above.

zones.name: Slums & Lower Wards
zones.theme: Dystopian High-Density Lower Wards & Red-Light Alleyways
zones.features: Towering brutalist tenement stacks, tangled overhead power conduits, narrow rain-slicked backstreets, and neon-lit street food stalls.
zones.sensory: Flickering holographic billboards reflecting in oily puddles, heavy synthwave bass thumping through walls, sirens wailing in the smog, and the smell of ozone and synthetic street noodles.

zones.name: Industrial Zone & Docks
zones.features: Massive automated container cranes, heavy smelting foundries, toxic runoff canals, and fortified corporate logistics warehouses.
zones.sensory: Screech of heavy robotic gantry cranes, intense heat from blast furnaces, chemical runoff stench, and rhythmic thumping of cargo transports.

zones.name: City Outskirts & Badlands
zones.theme: Arid Wasteland Beyond the City Walls
zones.features: Towering perimeter defense walls with auto-turrets, abandoned solar arrays, junked vehicle dumps, and nomad encampments.
zones.sensory: Howling hot winds carrying gritty dust, glaring desert sun, smell of burning fuel and rust, and the distant skyline of the city glowing on the horizon.

zones.name: Outlying Rural Town
zones.features: Massive bio-dome greenhouses, roadside motels, dusty gas stations, and small local diner bars.
zones.sensory: Hum of greenhouse climate controls, smell of synthetic fertilizer and dusty pavement, warm desert breeze, and quiet peace.

zones.name: Corporate Nature Reserve
zones.features: Giant geodesic glass dome enclosing engineered redwood trees, artificial waterfalls, sensor-monitored wildlife, and VIP walking paths.
zones.sensory: Synthesized pine breeze, gentle rush of filtered waterfalls, soft chirping of cyber-birds, and pristine clean air.

zones.name: Grand Clockwork Aerodrome & City Center
zones.features: Gargantuan wrought-iron clocktowers, elevated pneumatic airship docking gantries, labyrinthine copper pipe networks, and bustling brass streetcar plazas.
zones.sensory: Continuous hiss of high-pressure steam valves, rhythmic heavy thud of piston machinery, sulfurous coal smoke hanging in the air, and the clanking of giant brass cogs.

zones.name: Grand Zeppelin Cruiser
zones.features: Colossal rigid gasbag envelope, polished mahogany decks, panoramic observation gondola, roaring steam turbine engines, and pressurized crew quarters.
zones.sensory: Gentle swaying through cloud banks, deep rhythmic thrum of propeller turbines, smell of polished brass and pipe tobacco, and breathtaking vistas of the world below.

zones.name: Upper Brass Promenade
zones.features: Gilded gas-lamp lit streets, ornate brass opera houses, exclusive inventors' clubs, and pristine carriage avenues.
zones.sensory: Soft waltz music drifting from ballrooms, clinking champagne flutes, sweet pipe tobacco, and gentle hiss of ornamental gas fixtures.

zones.name: Underbelly Boiler Foundries
zones.features: Roaring blast furnaces, rivers of molten brass and iron, labyrinthine steam pipes, and soot-stained catwalks.
zones.sensory: Intense radiant heat, deafening clang of hydraulic forging hammers, thick sulfur fumes, and showering sparks of molten metal.

zones.features: Arched brick sewers with flowing canal waters, hidden illicit gambling dens, steam-pipe conduits, and clandestine dock landings.
zones.sensory: Echoing drips in vaulted brick tunnels, smell of stagnant water and lamp oil, muffled shouts from secret dens, and low chugging steam launches.

zones.features: Hulking skeletons of decommissioned steam-titans, acidic canal locks with wooden piers, scrap metal salvage dumps, and hidden smuggler depots.
zones.sensory: Heavy sulfuric fog rolling over brackish waterways, the metallic creak of corroded iron girders in the wind, damp rust scent, and the distant drip of condensation.

zones.sensory: Muffled silence in dense yellow smog, distant mournful train whistles, damp peat earth smell, and howling cold winds.

zones.features: Armored command bridge decks, compact crew quarters, insulated hyperdrive reactor chambers, and heavy engineering work bays.

zones.features: Towering crystalline spires rising above cloud layers, anti-gravity traffic lanes, grand planetary senate plazas, and vast terraformed botanical domes.
zones.sensory: Hum of repulsorlift engines, clean oxygenated air, warm golden sunlight reflecting off solar-glass monoliths, and chiming transit announcements.
